tips.text: Crack relics in fast Capture or Exterminate fissures on small tilesets with a full public squad; four rewards to pick from means more Ducats.
Run Defense fissures when they show up; the relic rotates every wave and the mission drops more relics.
Refine relics to Radiant when you can to raise the odds at the 45 and 100 Ducat parts.
Check your stash for relics with a 45 Ducat part in the common slot, such as Meso D8; they pay well even intact.
Try Void Cascade only with a competent group; matchmade Cascade is hit or miss.
Sell only duplicate Prime parts and parts from Primes you have already levelled.
Bank the Ducats and 350,000 credits between visits so you can buy it the moment Baro stocks it.
Players call it a low stress farm; crack relics between visits, sell duplicates as you go, and buy it next time it appears.
